data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'n-s-y', meaning 'to be gentle', 'to be kind'. The name Onsiyah symbolizes grace, tenderness, and elegance in Islamic culture. The name Onsiyah carries the meaning “Graceful, gentle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Onsiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
